name: ivschat
description: Introduction  The Amazon IVS Chat control-plane API enables you to create and manage Amazon IVS Chat resources.

subcommands.name: create-chat-token
subcommands.description: Creates an encrypted token that is used by a chat participant to establish an individual WebSocket chat connection to a room.

options.name: --room-identifier
options.description: Identifier of the room that the client is trying to access. Currently this must be an ARN

options.name: --user-id
options.description: Application-provided ID that uniquely identifies the user associated with this token. This can be any UTF-8 encoded text

options.name: --capabilities
options.description: Set of capabilities that the user is allowed to perform in the room. Default: None (the capability to view messages is implicitly included in all requests)

options.name: --session-duration-in-minutes
options.description: Session duration (in minutes), after which the session expires. Default: 60 (1 hour)

options.name: --attributes
options.description: Application-provided attributes to encode into the token and attach to a chat session. Map keys and values can contain UTF-8 encoded text.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
